_comment: Hand classification of every function the scanner reports (G03 B r4; carried into r5 and r6). Keys are file::function. class = lock class per spec r4 section A.3 (lane = lane holder; L2a..L2g lane-less classes; shared = AutoQueue rows only, L3; helper = runs inside its caller's class; startup = L2c; memory = no durable write of a target row; n/a = not a target row). owner = who owns the transaction. rule = the spec r4 requirement that governs it. r3 = whether spec r3's tables named it: listed / listed-wrong (named with a class the code does not have) / missing / n/a.
_machine_fields: G03 B1 (A13): lock / via / outside / after_commit / candidates are read by backend/tests/queue_writers/guard.py; see its docstring. Added over the r6 classification (research-artifacts/g03-b-spec-r6-2026-11-20/classification.json) by reading each case in the code.
_r5_changes: R21: raw-SQL sites now take their table from the DML verb (UPDATE <t> / DELETE FROM <t> / INSERT INTO <t>); 10 r4 sites were tables only read, DDL or literals (m002 x2, m018 x1, m019 seed x4, m062 x2, m066 x1) and are gone; 3 sites changed table (m002 lines 178/190 -> printer_queues, m066 line 83 -> auto_queue_items).

r5: recreate_table(conn, '<target>', ...) is a site (raw-sql, verb recreate): m007::upgrade and m019::upgrade are new functions (class migration); m018::upgrade keeps its entry through its recreate_table call.
m062::upgrade removed: its only r4 sites were CREATE TABLE calibration_session DDL naming print_queue in a REFERENCES clause.
r5 rule notes appended (" · r5 ...") for the functions R17-R20, the FK rule L6(b)/A24/A25 and the file-path lock A26 change; no class changed.
r5 adds an 'fk' field (A24) to every function that sets a foreign key of a queue table: held / free / null / own per column, from fk_inventory.json plus defer_claim's values(**values) read by hand.
_r6_changes: r6 appends rule notes (" · r6 ...") to the functions R22 (rebalance: target file before the order and AutoQueue rows), R23 (credits after the archive; the attach locks nothing under the file-path lock), R24 (one source-link rule) and the shape findings H1-H7 change; no key added or removed; one class string gains its package target (unskip_item: -> r6 lane:reusing_sources(queue_ids), A27), as r4's '-> lane' notes do.

r6 rewrites the fk field of _write_group, build_auto_queue_rows, restore_routing_source, _restore_source, _rearm, _copy_item_fields, _as_new_work, start_queue_item, enqueue_calibration_print, _assign and defer_claim (A24 as amended, A27, A28, A30).
